incidents.title: Oil rises as WTI jumps nearly 3%, Gulf attacks threaten crude supply recovery
incidents.description: Oil prices rose on Friday, extending their weekly recovery as renewed attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure and commercial shipping around the Strait of Hormuz heightened concerns that escalating Middle East hostilities could disrupt the recovery in regional crude supplies. incidents.title: Hormuz Tanker Traffic Rises This Month Even as Attacks Increase
incidents.description: Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has risen this month, according to data from Vortexa, even as attacks on vessels in the contested waterway have increased.
